name: recruiting-agent-site
description: Orbit public website with tested download and whole-page motion behavior.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:production
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/continuum.test.mjs test/continuum-pages.test.mjs test/signature-preview.test.mjs test/production-site.test.mjs test/pricing-parity.test.mjs test/unsubscribe-page.test.mjs test/seo-pages.test.mjs
scripts.test:legacy-home: node test/download-page.mjs && node test/handoff-page.mjs && node test/hero-quality.mjs && node test/scroll-legibility.mjs && node test/mobile-first.mjs && node test/mobile-complete-page.mjs
scripts.test:commercial: node --test test/pricing-parity.test.mjs && node test/commercial-pages.mjs && node --test test/unsubscribe-page.test.mjs && node --test test/seo-pages.test.mjs
